name: Figma
description: Figma designs and FigJam boards, opened without Figma. A .fig is the document rather than a picture of it, so the page is drawn from its own shapes and stays sharp however far in you go; beside it, the preview Figma saved, and a listing of the pages, the frames and their sizes, the fonts the design asks the machine for, what its text says and which components it is built from. Enter the file like a folder and each page is an SVG of its own, to walk with the cursor or copy out.
author: xverb
